summary: Sandisk Corp filed an 8-K announcing a $6 billion share repurchase program approved by its Board of Directors. The program allows for open-market purchases, including under Rule 10b5-1 plans, or other methods, with funding from operating cash flows. No specific price per share, premium, or timeline is stated; the program may be suspended or discontinued at any time. No advice is given. The filing also includes earnings results. This is a capital return event. Watch for future repurchase execution disclosures and impact on EPS.
